entries.text_en:
no. 31112 of the 17th century, p. 37 ff. Wl art retr; Wl lad; Hn, below, pp. 489. 483. 547, from Sc, collated with K 2.

no. 362, of the 17th century, pieces of the Quadripartitus, below, p. 529, from Br.

no. 438, beginning of the 17th century, p. 392 f. Mirce, Að, Had, below, pp. 462—68, from O.

no. 441, p. 5 Episc, below, p. 477, copied in 1688 from X.

no. 596, 16th century, f. 24 Af-Ine, below, p. 16, from H, collated with G; f. 36 (up to 54b everything from H) Ordal, below, p. 386; f. 36 II. V As, below, pp. 150. 166; EGu, below, p. 128; f. 39b I. II Ew, below, p. 138; f. 40v. I. II Em, below, p. 184; f. 41 I Atr, below, p. 216; f. 41b Wl lad, below, p. 483; f. 41b III Atr, below, p. 228; f. 42 In Cn, below, p. 612; f. 51b Wl art, below, p. 486; f. 52 VI As, below, p. 173; f. 54 Geþyncðo, below, p. 456; f. 54 Norðleod, below, p. 458; f. 54b Wif, below, p. 442; f. 55 V Atr, below, p. 236, from G 1; f. 58 I As, below, p. 146, from G. Then from A, collated with G: f. 58b II. III Eg, below, p. 194; f. 60b I. II Cn, below, p. 278.

Then again f. 73 Af-Ine, below, p. 16, from G.

Then again from H: f. 75 Had, below, p. 464; f. 76 Norðleod, below, p. 458, f. 76 Wif, below, p. 442.

Then follow ff. 79—111 Latin pieces of the Quadripartitus, mostly [or only?] from T, namely f. 79 Af-Ine, below, p. 17; f. 83b I. II As, below, p. 147; f. 92b AGu, below, p. 127; f. 96b I Atr, below, p. 217; f. 97 III Atr, below, p. 229; f. 97b IV Atr, below, p. 232; f. 99b Duns, below, p. 375; f. 100b VII Atr, below, p. 260; f. 101 Iudex, below, p. 474; f. 101b II. III Eg, below, p. 195; f. 102 III Em, below, p. 190; f. 103 Af with rubrics, below, pp. 539. 17. The Quadr. used belonged perhaps to class m. The copyist cites as his source a MS of Simonds d'Ewes. I do not find it in his library as catalogued by Bernard, nor among the Harleian MSS, where many of Simonds' MSS ended up.

Finally f. 113 Tripartita, i.e. Wl art, ECf retr, below, pp. 486. 627, from Lb.

Harley no. 785, 17th century, f. 6 ECf, below, p. 627; f. 116 Lib Lond, below, p. 673; f. 13 In Cn, below, p. 612, all from S; f. 20 Ps Cn for, below, p. 620, from Ho; f. 25 Hn piecemeal, below, p. 547, from Sc.

no. 814, 17th century, f. 24b Ps Cn for, below, p. 620, from Ho.

no. 1757, 16th century, f. 187 CHn cor, below, p. 521, in the hrl text.

no. 1866, c. 1700, Miss Elstob's copy from H: f. 1 Abt; f. 3b Hl; Wi, below, pp. 3. 9. 12. Cf. 6523.

no. 2058, 16th century, f. 4 Henry VIII's Inspeximus of Wl Lond, Hn Lond, below, pp. 486. 524, text as E IV.

no. 4143, 17th century, f. 1 II Eg, below, p. 194, from Ld.

no. 6523, from H, resembles no. 1866, is wrongly held to be the exemplar of Hearne's Textus Roffensis [so J. P. Gilson].

no. 7567, Hickes' transcript: f. 1 Abt, below, p. 3; III Atr, below, p. 228; VI As, below, p. 173, all from H.

editor_notes: n. 1866: Liebermann prints Wl, a misprint for Wi (Wihtred): the pages, 3, 9 and 12, are those of Abt, Hl and Wi.

transcription.doubts: Heading: only 'Harley' bold; 'im British Museum:' roman. The entry runs from the foot of p. xxviii col. 2 into p. xxix col. 1. Text above it on p. xxviii (both columns) continues the H entry from p. xxvii and was skipped. 'Harley n. 785' starts a new paragraph after a small gap but is not a heading. 'f. 116 Lib Lond' between f. 6 and f. 13 is as printed (perhaps a misprint for f. 11b/f. 11?). 'aus G 1' (V Atr) read as 'G 1' (OCR 'Gl'). 'u. S 173' (no full stop after S) in n. 7567 as printed. In n. 1866 the print (checked at 600 dpi) clearly has bold 'Wl', a misprint for Wi (pp. 3. 9. 12 = Abt, Hl, Wi); transcribed 'Wi'. Editor to decide whether to print 'Wl' as printed. 'lx' in note 12 is in small capitals (marked span class="smallcaps").
proof_notes: doubts: n. 1866 'Wi' confirmed as printed 'Wl' (misprint for Wi); kept 'Wi', flagged
